description.html: Ace Your Test in Style: Kick up your pencil case with these two assorted boxes of standard No. 2 pencils; they come in eye-catching pastel colors, such as pink, baby blue and mint, and are sure to catch compliments Made for Writing, Drawing & More: Suitable for ages 3 and up, these cute pencils feature an ergonomic triangle-shaped barrel and durable FSC-certified wood construction Ready for Schoolwork & Homework: Perfect for math, science, English, history and other classes, as well as work, these wood pencils are pre-sharpened with high-quality erasers and use a standard pencil sharpener Let Your Imagination Shine: Whether take these pencils with you to travel or summer camp, they’ll be your go-to tool to turn magical ideas into amazing realities We believe school supplies should be available for every child in every classroom, not at the expense of our teachers; to help ease some of the barriers to education, Yoobi creates fun, colorful products for school, home and office that give back; for each qualifying Yoobi item purchased, Yoobi Global, LLC will donate a Yoobi item to Kids in Need Foundation

Organize your life whether it’s with binders for school, document envelopes for travel, or file folders for medical records. Each have multiple pockets, keeping your doucments organized. They come in fun, bright colors or prints, making it easy to find in your backpack. Our binders with unique designs prove that fun can also be functional.

Not sure which Yoobi products to buy? All of our products help children in need, so you can't go wrong! There are so many fun and colorful school supplies to choose from, and these are our customers' favorites! Choose from colorful notebooks to binders, gel pens, markers and highlighters. Dont' forget a cute pencil case to store these in too! And for those Marvel fans, we have lots of fun school supplies featuring your favorite super hero, including Spider-Man, Captain American and other Avengers.
